classification_legend.SUPPORTED_FINDING: Observed on-chain evidence directly supports this scoped finding.
classification_legend.NEEDS_VERIFICATION: A signal exists, but transaction types or missing history prevent attribution.
classification_legend.SCOPED_NEGATIVE: No link was found within the stated dataset, depth, and time window.
classification_legend.INCOMPLETE: Observed data is useful, but reconciliation is not complete.

findings.evidence: CLiX directly funded the caller, GKM, and 1chd; the caller, GKM, and 1chd bought 13 called tokens in the same slot.
findings.limitations: Direct funding and repeated coordination do not identify the real-world key holder.

findings.evidence: 11 tokens have all four linked wallets in the caller’s exact slot; the other 2 have the caller/GKM/1chd trio in that slot.
findings.limitations: Same-slot execution is a coordination signal; it is not by itself proof of a bundled transaction or common ownership.

findings.finding: No additional linked-wallet first buys within −50 / +25 slots
findings.evidence: 37 linked-wallet first buys fall from 50 slots before through 25 slots after a caller first buy; all have a slot delta of zero.
findings.limitations: This compares the first observed buy per wallet/token in the collected early-buyer dataset, not every subsequent trade or activity outside the 97 calls.

findings.finding: 13 direct SOL transfers reached the caller
findings.limitations: Transfers are separate from token-position cash flow and do not establish profit attribution.

findings.finding: Caller transferred inventory to CLiX before CLiX exits
findings.evidence: 7 token-only transfers across 5 tokens moved from the caller to CLiX, followed by matching CLiX sales.
findings.limitations: The observed transfers establish token flow. They do not establish who controls either wallet or the original acquisition cost.

findings.finding: Recent direct activity continues across the four-wallet cluster
findings.evidence: 58 deduplicated direct transfer instructions across 36 recent signatures were observed after the last collected callout.
findings.limitations: Recent activity is complete only for CLiX in this export; caller, GKM and 1chd each reached the 1,000-record monitoring cap.

findings.evidence: 12 transaction/mint groups in 9 caller signatures sent the same asset to two or more linked wallets.
findings.limitations: This is a direct transfer-flow observation in the monitored interval; it does not establish beneficial ownership or the asset’s original cost basis.

findings.finding: Observed post-fan-out disposals with SOL receipts
findings.evidence: 37 unique wallet/mint disposal transactions occurred within six hours after a caller fan-out, with 39.781735116 SOL in observed wallet-level native-SOL deltas.
findings.limitations: These are sale/proceeds signals, not proven profit: acquisition cost, fees, full wallet history, and beneficial ownership are not established. Each exit is assigned once to its closest prior fan-out to avoid double counting.

findings.finding: No caller-to-founder link found within analyzed scope
findings.evidence: 97 calls; first-in funding traces up to three hops; 30-day pre-launch founder funding review.
findings.limitations: Four early-buyer wallets have unresolved first-in funding; service-like ancestry is not ownership evidence.
